description: Festiv's curated, data-ranked guides for Kuala Lumpur (fine dining, cafes, cocktail bars, Japanese, Korean, Italian, Thai, halal-certified restaurants, family-friendly places, spas, gyms, museums …). Without a topic it lists the guides; with a topic (slug or words like 'japanese restaurants') it returns the ranked entries with ratings, price level, cuisines and links. Rankings come from Google review data; nothing in them is sponsored.

topic.description: Guide slug or words; omit to list all guides.

outputSchema.description: Either the list of guides (`guides`) or one guide (`topic` + `entries`).
